comment: The media jdk-notrap.yml installs to run the JDK reproducer, copied from windows-images.json (ci-windows-matrix):
Windows 11 24H2 26100.1742 (affected) as shipped, and Windows 11 25H2 26200.7171 (gated kernel 26100.7171) with
feature 58474193 disabled (EnabledState 1, loses the state) and enabled (EnabledState 2, keeps it: the control).
Every medium is checked against its SHA-1 or ci/kernel-hashes.tsv before it boots, as in install-vm.sh.
